test_title: PYST 18: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 14 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The 'Atmanirbhar Oil Seeds Abhiyan' launched in Budget 2025 focuses on:

options.text: importing high-quality seeds for oil production

solution:
The Correct answer is __**achieving self-sufficiency in oilseed production**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **'Atmanirbhar Oil Seeds Abhiyan'** was launched as part of the **Budget 2025** to enhance India's capability to meet domestic demand for oilseeds and reduce reliance on imports.
 
• This initiative focuses on **achieving self-sufficiency** in the production of oilseeds such as **mustard, soybean, groundnut, and sunflower**.
 
• The program aims to improve agricultural practices by promoting **modern farming techniques** and providing support to farmers through **subsidies** and **training programs**.
 
• India has been one of the largest importers of edible oils, and the initiative seeks to **reduce import dependency** by increasing domestic production.
 
• Farmers will be encouraged to cultivate oilseed crops by offering incentives such as **minimum support prices (MSP)** and financial assistance.
 
• It includes the adoption of **high-yield varieties**, improved irrigation systems, and soil health management to boost productivity.
 
• The program aligns with the vision of **'Atmanirbhar Bharat'**, which aims to make India self-reliant in critical sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Exporting surplus oil seeds**__

 __
 
• India does not produce surplus oilseeds for export. Instead, it is a significant importer of edible oils like **palm oil and soybean oil**.
 
• Exporting surplus oilseeds would contradict the goal of achieving self-sufficiency in oilseed production.
 
 
 
• **Subsidising edible oil prices**__
 __
 
• Subsidising edible oil prices is a temporary measure to manage market fluctuations and does not address the root cause of dependency on imports.
 
• The focus of the initiative is on **production enhancement**, not price subsidies.
 
 
 
• **Importing high-quality seeds for oil production**__
 
 
• While importing high-quality seeds may improve yields, the long-term goal of the program is to develop **indigenous high-yield varieties** and reduce external dependency.
 
• This option does not align with the self-reliance focus of **'Atmanirbhar Oil Seeds Abhiyan'**.
